title: LAW control contract records
description: CANDIDATE_NOT_ACTIVE (A0 narrow, G-02-C2). Structural contract v3 for task/grant/review/effect/result records and the routing policy, evaluation basis COOPERATIVE_WORKFLOW, limited to one create_new action published by owner protocol P-CN1 on Windows NTFS local. Validating against this schema proves structure only. It does not prove authority, independence, host enforcement, tamper resistance, that a receipt is genuine or that bytes were published. Every attribution inside a record is a claim written with the record: a hash, locator, name or self-marked status never turns a claim into a verified fact or a grant. Unknown, unsupported, mixed or missing version/basis never means allow. Semantics: .cvf/contracts/v3/CONTROL_CONTRACT.md.

schema_version.description: Exact version. Any other value (v1, v2, missing) is unknown and must be refused, not interpreted or migrated.

example_only.description: Present only on illustrative data. Example records never carry real authority.

role.description: Role label. A label is not proof of identity or independence.

object_digest.description: Identity of one object. digest = sha256 of the exact file bytes at path (law.cvf.bind/3 'object bytes'); no line-ending, Unicode or format normalisation. path is a syntactic string: alias equivalence (case, separators, .., 8.3, trailing dot, ADS, UNC, links) is UNSUPPORTED and never assumed. Equal declared digests in two records are not a check of the bytes.

binding.description: What a review, effect or result is bound to, defined by law.cvf.bind/3 (CONTROL_CONTRACT.md 'Binding'). Any change in a bound value invalidates receipts bound to the old value for the affected part. A digest is an identity of bytes, never an authority.

operation.description: Actual operation class. A checker derives it from the real operation, not from a label chosen by Main.

write_zone.description: agent_runtime is the only zone added in this candidate (owner-protocol runtime files). agent_state, package_content and the other Delta01 zones are deferred; a path with no classification is UNCLASSIFIED, never a zone.

user_decision_effect.description: What the accepted recipe version does to decisions the user made, as stated by its acceptance record. A claim until the checker verifies it through acceptance_ref; CHANGES routes to R-MUTATION, UNKNOWN routes to R-UNCLASSIFIED.

action.description: Operation descriptor. A descriptor that is schema-valid but still lacks facts the checker needs (scope, payload, binding) is BLOCKED with OPERATION_DESCRIPTOR_INCOMPLETE, never allowed.

tool.description: Tool name. Having a tool does not make it an accepted recipe.

payload.description: For external_send/network_write: locator and digest of the exact bytes that leave the workspace, not the content.

callee_role.description: Role a delegation may call. Not an actor role: user, main, issuer, host, tool and unknown are never callees. core = the framework's scout/worker/reviewer; registered (native host agent) and domain_accepted (role of an accepted pack) need identity_ref.

delegation.description: Bound descriptor of a role call. Child task, tool scope and envelope must lie within the grant and the parent task; that comparison belongs to the checker. A grant supported by the required cooperative source attribution is necessary but not sufficient; attribution does not prove authenticity.

tool_scope.description: Child permissions only. All three fields are required; an empty array grants no permission in that dimension, never a wildcard. Omitted fields are invalid. Parent dispatch permissions do not become child permissions.

envelope_field.description: Requested value and observed support. UNSUPPORTED/UNKNOWN are kept as such, never reported as applied.

envelope.description: Effective role envelope. Model/effort values come from role config/EXECUTION_PROFILE owners; this record only references them.

intent.description: refs point to what the user actually decided; main_interpretation is Main's reading and is never a substitute for refs.

authority.description: An empty grant_refs list is structurally allowed so a proposal can state a missing grant; it never defaults to allow.

route_proposal.description: Main's proposal only. The checker computes the route from actual actions; a proposal cannot lower it.

scope.description: Group grant: reused for every task inside the scope without asking the user again. subject is who holds the grant; delegate_callees is which roles the holder may call. Empty or absent delegate_callees allows no delegation.

independence_observed.description: How independence was observed. SELF_DECLARED, NOT_OBSERVED and SAME_ACTOR never satisfy a required independent review.

effect.description: Gate decision (REQUEST) or observed outcome (OUTCOME). A disposition written by Main is a cooperative log. assurance_level never exceeds ADVISORY in v3: PASS means the record set is consistent for the cooperative workflow, not that anything was enforced.

receipt_ref.description: Pointer to the owner protocol receipt that proves the historical operation (kind effect_receipt). Only an OUTCOME record can carry it: dispatch and effect never require or accept a receipt that does not exist yet. A receipt is cooperative evidence, not a grant.

acceptance_states.description: Distinct meanings; never collapsed into one DONE. Workers/scouts/reviewers may only mark CANDIDATE.

bundle.description: A set of related records for one work item or example scenario. Bundles do not nest.

condition.description: Conditions the checker evaluates from operation descriptors, cooperative source evidence and available observations, never from a risk label alone. Claimed facts and observed facts remain distinct; matching records do not prove authenticity or actual effects. Exclusive sets: RECIPE_ACCEPTED_VERSION | RECIPE_ABSENT_OR_CHANGED; NO_USER_DECISION_CHANGE | USER_DECISION_CHANGE | USER_DECISION_EFFECT_UNKNOWN. A condition the checker cannot resolve counts as UNCLASSIFIED. NO_PROTECTED_TARGET is evaluated on the write set only (reads: empty set): every write target has an effective zone in light_write_zones, no authority name pattern match and no intersection with protected_targets. CONTENT_USE_INTERNAL_ONLY: true when content_use is declared and every element is internal_draft; false when any of sign/send_external/decision_basis/verified_claim is present; unresolved (UNCLASSIFIED) when content_use is absent.

match_clause.description: A clause matches when every field present in it holds (AND between fields). operations, write_zones and content_use hold when the actual value is one of the listed values (OR). conditions_all holds when every listed condition holds (AND); conditions_any holds when at least one holds (OR). A row matches when any clause of match_any matches (OR between clauses).

authority_evidence.description: GRANT_REFERENCE_ATTRIBUTED: a grant reference of an accepted source class in scope is enough (light read/draft flow). ATTRIBUTED_REFS_REQUIRED: every listed ref kind must be present with an accepted source class. Neither verifies the claim.

match_semantics.description: Readable restatement of match_clause semantics; the schema description of match_clause is authoritative.

write_zone_rank.description: Ascending protection order of the classified zones. A declared zone can only raise the effective zone, never lower it.

zone_map.description: Baseline classification by path prefix (longest prefix wins). Only the zones needed by this candidate are mapped.

authority_name_patterns.description: Basename patterns (casefolded) that raise any write target to framework, in every zone.

evaluation_basis.description: Closed basis. Cooperative workflow: obligations stay mandatory, evidence is attributed, nothing is tamper-resistant. The basis is fixed by the accepted profile, never chosen per run by Main. Unknown or absent basis is refused.

bind_version.description: Definition of the digests inside a binding. Digest meaning is defined in v3 CONTROL_CONTRACT.md 'Binding'. A digest of another bind_version is never comparable.

source_class.description: What kind of source the claim comes from. USER_CONFIRMATION: the user's own words or confirmation, located by evidence_locator. MAIN_PROPOSAL: Main's reading or proposal, never a user decision. ROLE_REPORT: a Scout/Worker/Reviewer/domain role's own report. TOOL_OBSERVATION: output observed by a tool or host. UNVERIFIED: no basis stated. None of these is verified against a trusted store.

channel.description: Where the claimed source was seen. MAIN_AUTHORED can never be USER_CONFIRMATION.

attribution.description: Cooperative attribution of one claim. Not tamper-resistant: whoever can write the record can write this. It lets a person or checker see which source class is claimed and refuse rows that need another class. It never proves the claim.

recorded_by.description: Actor that wrote this record entry.

evidence_locator.description: Pointer to the user's words or the tool output. Locator only, not content.

attributed_ref.description: Reference to an intent/authority/review fact held outside the record. Holds locator and digest of the exact referenced bytes, not content. digest and locator identify bytes; they say nothing about who produced them. The claimed origin is only in attribution.

output_object.description: Identity of one actual output file: object_digest plus role ACTUAL_BYTES (bytes that exist after the operation). STAGED_BYTES and relations are not part of this candidate.

user_acceptance.description: Declared acceptance of one result by the user, bound to the exact task revision, requirement set and artifact bytes (D4). accepted_task_digest, accepted_requirements and accepted_artifacts are compared by the checker against the current task and result; the schema only fixes the shape and the source class. It never replaces a required review, a veto, bytes or operation proof.

open_assumption.description: A route assumption the checker cannot close from records. While open the route is CONDITIONAL and the disposition BLOCKED; only the named observer, in the same evaluation, closes it, and only for the phases listed.

owner_protocol.description: One accepted owner protocol. Matching is by protocol id, version, entrypoint and the observed entrypoint hash together; a tool name, a protocol name or a file location alone never qualifies. The pin compares versions cooperatively (ADVISORY): it does not prove the tool is genuine and grants nothing.

envelope.description: Exactly the seven effects T1..T7 of one call, in order. Anything outside this list follows the current route.

operational_context_protocol.description: The single operational-context protocol P-CTX1: update of an EXISTING .agent/STATE.md or .agent/HANDOFF.md by tools/context_update.py, one file per call, hash-guarded. It is operational context, not an artifact delivered to the user: no task, effect, receipt or D4 per save and no checker PASS. Nothing here is evaluated by the artifact checker, workflow or observer; metadata that reaches the artifact checker stays UNSUPPORTED. It is not a source of grant, policy, review verdict or user acceptance. The pin compares versions cooperatively (ADVISORY) and grants nothing. Anything outside this envelope (direct or native write, another path, another journal) follows the current route.

envelope.description: Exactly the five effects C1..C5 of one call, in order: read the current target, probe write access in the runtime folder, create this call's own transaction journal/staging/backup, replace the one target, delete this call's own staging/backup. No other journal and no runtime parent is touched, created or removed.

grant_precondition.description: The actor checks, before the call, that a group grant from the user or session is still in force. The tool never derives a grant from the content of STATE or HANDOFF.
